svg.title: If their assumptions hold, five of the seven scenarios beyond the baseline would lift at least one outcome family by 2036.
svg.desc: A table of eight scenarios for 2036 against four outcome families: quality of democracy, government efficacy, economic performance, and income and wealth equality. Each cell gives the atlas’s direction words with Oath & Action’s arrow. Five of the seven scenarios beyond the baseline would lift at least one family if their assumptions hold, and in the baseline each family stays flat or falls.
svg.text: Oath & Action’s reading, by arrow and tint

text.tspan: Parties first: fusion voting and public
